plugins.name: rhyolite
plugins.description: Rhyolite is an open-source software analysis platform. Its initial, default, and currently only shipped module is repo-review, delivered here as a GitHub Copilot plugin for read-only analysis of public HTTPS Git repositories and optional provenance review for agentically generated code.
